basis: Autoimmune lymphocytic inflammation of the thyroid causes transient hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism.
Epilepsy, ataxia and renal electrolyte wasting define the syndrome; sensorineural hearing impairment occurs in 5/5 patients.
Mediastinal soft tissue lies outside the specified axes; origin in lung, pleura, heart, vessels or locomotor connective tissue is not established.
Selective congenital absence of teeth; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Esophageal achalasia, microcephaly and intellectual disability define the syndrome; dermatoglyphic differences do not establish skin damage.
Intestinal infection produces toxin-mediated neuromuscular junction dysfunction; respiratory weakness and ocular motor findings do not establish intrinsic lung or eye damage.
Severe cardiovascular and skeletal disease with emphysema (100%); ectopia lentis occurs in 80-99%. Cutis laxa (80-99%) omitted because of the cap.
Congenital trigeminal sensory loss; neurotrophic corneal injury is a usual presentation (>30% estimated). Facial and oral ulcer frequencies are uncertain.
Excess thyroid hormone production arises within the thyroid; autoimmune causation does not apply across all subtypes.
Purely psychiatric anxiety disorder without established damage to an organ axis.
Pontocerebellar hypoplasia and neonatal hypotonia establish neurologic disease; respiratory insufficiency alone does not establish intrinsic pulmonary damage.
Structural corneal thinning and ectasia impair vision.
Benign neoplasm of the prostate, a reproductive organ; urinary tract damage is not established across the group.
Malignant neoplasm involving bones of the limbs.
Carcinoma arises in the uterine corpus, outside the specified axes; bleeding alone does not establish hematologic disease.
Pontocerebellar malformation and severe developmental delay; strabismus 3/3 and liver dysfunction 1/1 support involvement, with substantial uncertainty from small samples.
Defined by a longitudinal hypopigmented streak of the mediosternal skin.
Acute neuronopathic storage disease; splenic involvement 80-99%, cytopenias 30-79%, hepatic infiltration 80-99%. Pulmonary involvement 30-79% omitted at cap.
Benign neoplasm arising in the uterine cervix; its smooth muscle component does not establish locomotor system involvement.
Colonic adenomatous polyposis defines AFAP; gastric and duodenal polyps share the same axis. Extracolonic tumors are minority findings or separate diseases.
Airway ciliary dysfunction causes bronchiectasis; middle-ear dysfunction with recurrent otitis and hearing impairment is reported in 1/1 patients.
Fibrosarcoma arises in the liver; fibroblastic histology does not establish musculoskeletal organ involvement.
Inherited melanin pigmentation disorder affecting ocular development and vision; skin and hair pigmentation are normal or only slightly diluted.
Psychiatric behavioral disorder; the developmental parent category does not establish neurologic organ damage.
Inherited autoinflammatory interferonopathy; AGS-like inflammatory encephalopathy predominates (>30% estimated). Skin involvement frequency across the umbrella is uncertain.
